blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Board of Investments (BOI) found no irregularities in Cale88 Foods Corp.’s export transactions involving Chinese companies, a defense witness testified at Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial on Friday. Cale88, a banana chips manufacturing company linked to Duterte’s husband, lawyer Manases Carpio, came under scrutiny during the prosecution’s presentation of evidence showing the company received P319 million in remittances from China. On the 45th day of Duterte’s trial, Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) Undersecretary for Industry Development and Trade Policy Group Ceferino Rodolfo explained that Cale88 is registered with the BOI as an export enterprise.
